subject: Clarify audit window and bridge letter applicability for hybrid hosting
messages:
From: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@willowbank.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Willowbank Security <security@willowbank.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge / scope questions

Hi Connor,

We're kicking off the security review for our upcoming procurement and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and a bridge letter that would extend coverage if the report period doesn't align with our review window. Specific asks:

- Copy of the SOC 2 Type II report covering the last audit period (report period and testing window).
- A bridge letter or statement of controls if the report period ends before Aug 31, 2027.
- Confirmation whether the report covers Redwood-hosted API, Redwood Dedicated pools, and Redwood Private/VPC or on-prem deployments. Our procurement team needs explicit scope language for vendor risk.
- If possible, a tenant mapping or statement confirming whether dedicated pools (we have a pool called WB-Prod-Pool in us-west-2) are included in the report scope and whether tenant isolation controls are in place.

We're trying to finalize contractual terms by 7/15; can you confirm what you can provide and timing?

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Torres
Senior Security Analyst
Willowbank Financial

Attachments: procurement-soc2-requests.pdf (requested artifact list)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@willowbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge / scope questions

Hi Elaine — thanks for the summary and deadline. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter. Quick clarifications so we send the right artifacts:

- Audit period: our latest Type II report covers 2027-01-01 through 2027-06-30 (testing window ends 2027-06-30).
- Scope: generally, Redwood's SOC 2 Type II covers Redwood-managed services — that includes the hosted public API and Redwood-managed Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools that are run & managed by Redwood).
- Private/VPC or customer on-prem deployments are typically out-of-scope for Redwood's SOC 2 when the networking and compute are customer-managed (VPC peering, customer-owned infrastructure).

To confirm whether WB-Prod-Pool is in-scope: please tell me the account/cluster ID or confirm whether that pool is provisioned as Redwood Dedicated under your Redwood contract (i.e., managed by Redwood, not self-hosted). If so, we can include a tenant mapping and evidence.

We'll attach the SOC 2 PDF and a bridge-letter template for signature. If you prefer, we can schedule a short call with compliance and engineering to walk through the details — are you available 7/6 or 7/7?

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20270101-20270630.pdf (full report), Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Template.pdf

From: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@willowbank.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Willowbank Security <security@willowbank.com>
Date: 2027-07-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge / scope questions

Thanks, Connor.

Quick answers:
- WB-Prod-Pool is provisioned via Redwood Dedicated (Redwood manages the pool and upgrades) and the pool identifier in our procurement paperwork is RBW-9482 (you may see that in your tenant mapping).
- We also have a subset of workloads that will run in a customer-managed VPC (peered) for highly regulated data — that VPC is NOT managed by Redwood.

Procurement timeline: we need the scope confirmation and bridge letter signed by 7/15 to keep our legal timeline.

Also attaching our required artifact checklist (procurement-soc2-requests.pdf) — the items we will request: evidence of tenant isolation, sample audit logs, network topology for WB-Prod-Pool, and a short controls matrix mapping.

Can Marissa or your compliance lead provide the tenant mapping and a brief note about isolation boundaries for RBW-9482?

Elaine

Attachments: procurement-soc2-requests.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@willowbank.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-04T16:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge / scope questions

Hi Elaine — Marissa on compliance here. Appreciate the clear asks; below are the specifics and what we'll attach.

1) Report period and bridge letter
- SOC 2 Type II report: testing period 2027-01-01 through 2027-06-30. Attached: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20270101-20270630.pdf.
- Bridge letter: we can issue a dated bridge letter extending cover for controls through 2027-08-31; draft attached (Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Template.pdf). We'll need a signatory from Willowbank (DocuSign link included) to finalize for procurement.

2) Scope: which hosting modes are in-scope
- In-scope: Redwood-hosted API endpoints and Redwood-managed Dedicated capacity (reserved pools that Redwood operates on our infrastructure). If WB-Prod-Pool (RBW-9482) is provisioned as a Redwood Dedicated pool under your contract, it is in-scope and we can include tenant-level mappings and sample evidence.
- Out-of-scope: customer-managed VPCs or on-prem deployments where compute/network is operated by the customer. For those, Redwood does not assert SOC 2 coverage. If the customer asks us to operate the environment under Redwood-managed hosting, we can discuss contractual options to bring it into scope for future audits.

3) Tenant isolation and evidence we can provide
- Dedicated pools use tenant-level logical isolation and are segmented at the hypervisor/network layer. We can provide: tenant mapping (redwood-dedicated-tenant-mapping.csv), a network topology diagram for WB-Prod-Pool (network-topology-wb-prod-pool.pdf), and redacted sample audit logs showing access controls.
- We will redact sensitive fields as appropriate before sharing.

4) Next steps and timing
- I'll attach the tenant mapping and topology PDF in the next email.
- If you confirm that RBW-9482 is the pool in question, we'll produce the tenant mapping and a short evidence bundle by 7/09; draft bridge letter can be sent for signature same day.
- If you'd like a 30-minute call to walk through the artifacts, Connor and I are available 7/06 11:00am PT or 7/07 9:00am PT.

Please confirm the pool ID (RBW-9482) and whether you want the bridge letter signed by a specific Willowbank contact.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments in this thread: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20270101-20270630.pdf, Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Template.pdf, redwood-dedicated-tenant-mapping.csv, network-topology-wb-prod-pool.pdf
